description: A window on top of the page that asks for the user's attention, such as a short form or details. The page behind is dimmed.
tip: A dialog closes with the × button, the Esc key, or a click outside. For confirming important actions that must not close by accident, use Alert Dialog.

scroll.title: Long Content
scroll.description: Limit the dialog height; only the middle scrolls, while the title and buttons stay visible.

parts.trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
parts.content: The dialog window (includes the dimmed backdrop and the × button).
parts.title: Dialog title (read by screen readers).
parts.close: Wrap any element to make it close the dialog.

props.onOpenChange: Called when the dialog opens or closes.
props.showCloseButton: Show the × button in the top-right corner.
props.footerClose: Add a "Tutup" (close) button to the footer.
